iterations.observedFailure: Repeatedly visiting exhausted grass landmarks without obtaining materials; lighting eventually ran out at night.
changes: Skip currently non-harvestable plants and explore when known sources are exhausted.
Extend procurement budgets only for actual resource or crafting progress, not navigation arrivals.
iterations.validation: Targeted regressions fail on old source and pass on repaired source; syntax and related checks passed. The repaired version was then used in iteration 2.

iterations.observedFailure: A clockwork rook killed the character after retreats ended too near its acquisition range and procurement paths re-entered danger.
changes: Use the native rook acquisition distance for proactive avoidance.
Check threats along entire navigation segments, including direct routes and waypoint handoffs.
Keep retreating until a safe separation is reached before resuming procurement.
iterations.validation: Six targeted threat/retreat regressions and related checks passed. The repaired version was then used in iteration 3.

iterations.observedFailure: A visible tallbird repeatedly attacked while the client threat list remained empty because native tallbirds do not have the hostile tag.
changes: Recognize visible tallbirds using their native tag/prefab without classifying neutral animals as threats.
Cover native target acquisition and nest defense distances, including the spring multiplier.
Reuse full-segment avoidance and emergency retreat/preemption.
iterations.validation: Three targeted threat regressions fail on old source and pass on repaired source. Exploration feedback, syntax and related checks passed. No subsequent game run was started.

previouslyCompleted: Automatic Wilson lobby selection, spawning and survival startup entirely inside the client Mod.
Native inventory self-actions support keyboard/mouse clients as well as host and remote prediction modes.
CHOP/MINE/HAMMER hold native work controls across repeated swings and release on cancel, preemption or failure.
Lighting inventory preparation is separate from equipment; natural-light checks prevent premature torch consumption.
Safe navigation waypoints hand off movement continuously, with final arrival and cancellation preserved.
Death bundles persist before emitting short notifications to avoid the native 4095-byte log-line limit.
Resource review records inventory, equipment condition, ambient light and night countdown; suspected waste remains an evidence-based review item.
Native pause is confirmed independently by both shards after evidence capture.
Controller JSON replacement retries transient Windows sharing failures for up to two seconds, preserving old state on failure.
remainingValidation: Sustained survival for 70 actual game days across all four seasons.
Long-run procurement, food, temperature, combat avoidance and inventory behavior.
Visual continuity of prolonged work/movement and continued execution while the window is unfocused.
privacy: Only derived findings are distributed; raw sessions, user/account identifiers, credentials, logs, captures and world saves stay with their original owner.
